manualPackageFollowup.newFact: ManualFragment downloads the selected ZipInfo.zipUrl and unzips it. LocalPathUtil.getNameFromPath removes every non-word character from the final URL path component, so a .zip filename becomes extensionless. A filename suffix census therefore cannot rule out this distinct runtime package cache.
manualPackageFollowup.manifestSurvival: ManualRunnable.insertToDb stores ZipInfo zipUploadTime, zipUrl, zipSize, targetFile and serverFilepath. transformData reconstructs ZipInfo from response JSON. These provide a concrete existing-package locator if such an original sanitized manifest is already retained.
